title: Where the jumps happen, by video length
lede: Long-form videos first observed in YouTube Most Popular, channels whose usual video gets 10K–100K views. Share that reached 2× their channel's usual or more on day 1.
ylab: SHARE AT 2× OR MORE ON DAY 1
note: Short or very long. The middle is the hardest place to jump.
src: 929 videos, 11 days, one baseline band; live streams, TV episodes and films excluded. Usual = median views of the channel's long-form videos published 7–90 days before. A pattern in this population, not a cause.
